attractions.name: Eiffel Tower
attractions.description: The iconic iron lattice tower on the Champ de Mars. Visit at sunset for the most magical views or after dark for the glittering light show every hour.
attractions.address: Champ de Mars, 5 Av. Anatole France, 75007 Paris, France

attractions.name: The Louvre Museum
attractions.description: The world's largest art museum and historic monument. Home to over 35,000 works including the Mona Lisa and Venus de Milo. Book tickets in advance.

attractions.name: Musée d'Orsay
attractions.description: Housed in a stunning Beaux-Arts railway station, this museum holds the world's largest collection of Impressionist masterpieces by Monet, Renoir, and Van Gogh.
attractions.address: 1 Rue de la Légion d'Honneur, 75007 Paris, France

attractions.name: Notre-Dame Cathedral
attractions.description: The masterpiece of Gothic architecture on the Île de la Cité. Partially restored after the 2019 fire, the exterior and surroundings remain breathtaking.
attractions.address: 6 Parvis Notre-Dame, Pl. Jean-Paul II, 75004 Paris, France

attractions.name: Sacré-Cœur Basilica & Montmartre
attractions.description: Perched atop the highest point in Paris, this stunning white basilica offers panoramic city views. The surrounding Montmartre district is full of artists, cafés, and cabarets.
attractions.address: 35 Rue du Chevalier de la Barre, 75018 Paris, France

attractions.name: Palace of Versailles
attractions.description: The former royal residence of French kings — an opulent baroque palace with the Hall of Mirrors, stunning royal apartments, and 800 hectares of formal gardens.

attractions.name: Le Marais District
attractions.description: Paris's trendiest neighbourhood, blending medieval history with contemporary art galleries, designer boutiques, Jewish heritage, and some of the city's best falafel.

attractions.name: Seine River Cruise (Bateaux Mouches)
attractions.description: A 1-hour boat cruise along the Seine offering iconic views of Paris's most famous monuments — the Eiffel Tower, Notre-Dame, and the Louvre from the water.
attractions.address: Port de la Conférence, Pont de l'Alma, 75008 Paris, France
